MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

2. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 8
   D. 24.5

3. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15.7
   C. 21
   D. 15

4. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 31.6

5. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 1

6. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 0.025
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.25

7. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x > 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

8. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 40.5
   B. 10
   C. 9
   D. 81

9. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 100 m²

10. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. Cannot tell

11. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 2
   D. 1

12. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 31
   D. 1

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 45
   C. 18
   D. 30

14. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 43

15. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 2
   D. 1

16. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. 3/4

17. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

18. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 28
   C. 22
   D. 14

19. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 29
   C. 23.6
   D. 23

20. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.7
   C. 27
   D. 27.6

21. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19.6
   C. 19
   D. 25

22. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/2

23. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 4
   C. 16
   D. 8

24. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 34
   C. 22
   D. 66

25. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 42
   C. 90
   D. 21

26. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

27. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 16
   C. 17
   D. 0

28. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 14
   C. 50
   D. 49

29. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 12

30. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 1
   C. 5
   D. 7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

33. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

37. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

38. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

39. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

40. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
